# kellyredding

> one builder. more than enough.

kellyredding LLC is a single-member software company run by Kelly Redding.
One person designs, builds, ships and maintains the whole thing — architecture
through deployment. Not an agency, not a team, and not a limitation.

Kelly works across the full stack, mostly in Ruby and JavaScript, and is based
in Dallas, Texas.

## What he builds

Applications, tools, websites, APIs, command-line utilities, SaaS products and
prototypes — complete, from the first commit through to production and the
support that follows it.

## Links

These four are the canonical places to find Kelly. All of them are the same
person.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/kellyredding): Source. Open-source Ruby gems, developer tooling and dotfiles across roughly fifty public repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kellyredding-is-kellyredding/): Professional history and experience.
- [EveryExpert](https://everyexpert.com/kellyredding): Expert profile.
- [Email](mailto:kelly@kellyredding.com): Direct contact, and the fastest way to reach him.

## Contact
